summary: Prove campaign goals and produce an auditable handoff
description: Add a bounded-goal completion audit and compact run report that distinguish task completion, delivered user outcomes, deferred work and the continuing product vision. Scope and mandate: .go/plans/autonomy-first.json. Reuse released ABC/advice/readiness behavior; implement only this delta.
acceptance: An empty queue plus declared success_metrics cannot prove success. Audit every adopted goal outcome against current product evidence and relevant architecture conformance; distinguish achieved, partial, blocked and explicitly excluded outcomes.
Discover missing work only within the original mandate and bounded follow-up allowance; deduplicate it. Broader vision ideas remain proposals and cannot expand the night run indefinitely.

Morning/readback report links original request, decisions, tasks, commits, tested candidates, releases/deployments and exact live receipts; clearly distinguishes live, locally verified, pending and user decisions.
All execution entrypoints used for campaign completion apply the same outcome audit. Invalidated or absent evidence fails completion; historical task records are not reinterpreted as fresh proof.

Complete this independently shippable stack change with content-bound checks/critic, scoped commit/push, immutable release and remote readback; preserve user dirt and historical evidence. Current request authorizes planning only; no execution or publication starts during intake.
verification: uv run --no-project --python 3.12 --with 'pytest>=8,<9' --with 'jsonschema>=4.23' python -m pytest tests/test_autonomy_goal_audit.py tests/test_abc_completion.py tests/test_autonomy_campaign.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
